name: Asteroids Modern
shortDescription: A neon-infused, mobile-first reimagining of the classic Asteroids arcade game with fluid touch controls and synthwave aesthetics.

generation.notes: Implemented relative touch rotation for better mobile UX and a high-contrast neon aesthetic.

suggestion.prompt:
## App Suggestion

**Category:** Games
**Requestor:** Perplexity

### Description

Build a mobile\-first Asteroids\-style browser game with modern JS, HTML, CSS, and Canvas\. Core loop: rotating ship, thrust with inertia, bullets, screen wrap, asteroid splitting, waves, score, lives, brief post\-death invulnerability\. Prioritize excellent touch controls: large left\-thumb rotation area or virtual stick; right\-thumb thrust and fire buttons; smooth acceleration, subtle damping, capped max speed so it feels precise, not slippery\. Add desktop keyboard controls\. Use modern visuals: glowing ship, engine thrust flame, particle trails, juicy explosions with debris and shockwaves, parallax starfield\. Include HUD \(score, lives, wave\), start/pause/game\-over screens, and keep code clean, modular, and performant\.

improvements.description: Add light/dark mode canvas background, visible bullet glow, parallax starfield, ship nose indicator, and fix constant asteroid speed on mobile
Add enemy UFO with aimed shots, force field shield, hyperspace teleport, and standardized mobile control buttons with icons
